verdict.rationale: The SDK lets code provision a sandbox programmatically with getSandbox(), which gets or creates one by ID. It can then run code via exec() and the interpreter, capturing stdout, stderr, exit codes and returned values, and read results back with readFile(), all without a human in the loop. Teardown is the weak link: the pack documents no explicit destroy or delete call. One community report notes there is no idle auto-destroy, so implementers must do their own cleanup, while another notes containers auto-shutdown when they stop receiving requests. Missing for 10: a documented explicit sandbox teardown/destroy API, controllable lifecycle cleanup, and independent hands-on corroboration of an agent running the full loop end to end.
